image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a man in formal attire, likely a groom. He is wearing a grey suit jacket, a white dress shirt with a stiff collar, and a patterned tie. His head is bowed, looking downward, and his right hand is visible near his chest, adjusting his cuff or jacket. The background is blurred (bokeh), suggesting an outdoor setting.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Hair is short, neat, and appears professionally styled. Facial hair is trimmed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Confident posture typical of wedding ceremony.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subject's head is bowed and eyes are closed/downcast. While this could be a moment of prayer or reflection, it does not visually match the 'confident posture' descriptor which typically implies upright stance and eye contact. Furthermore, posture is largely untestable in a tight close-up crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Formal facial presentation for ceremonial occasion.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subject is clean-shaven/trimmed and presents a solemn, appropriate look for a formal event.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dark suit or tuxedo with white dress shirt.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Subject wears a grey suit jacket (formal) and a crisp white dress shirt. Matches the formal attire requirement.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Necktie or bow tie at collar.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A patterned necktie is clearly visible under the shirt collar.
The left lapel is partially visible but no boutonniere is present. This is a common optional accessory, so its absence doesn't negate the class, but the checkpoint is strictly not met.
Feet are completely outside the frame of the image.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Accessories include pocket square, cufflinks, and wedding ring.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No pocket square is visible in the breast pocket. Cufflinks are obscured by the hand/jacket angle. No wedding ring is clearly visible on the hand shown.
The visible portions of the attire (suit, shirt, tie) are consistent with formal ceremonial wear.

artifact_observations.location: Tie pattern and shirt collar edge
artifact_observations.reasoning: The pattern on the tie appears slightly 'mushy' or low-frequency compared to the sharpness of the shirt collar. There is minor aliasing where the tie meets the shirt placket, suggesting slight generation softness rather than optical blur.

The hand adjusting the cuff is somewhat indistinct. The fingers blend into the white cuff without clear definition of knuckles or nail beds. It looks anatomically plausible but lacks the structural clarity of a real photograph, appearing slightly 'waxy'.

To verify the anatomical correctness of the neck, shoulder, and arm structure, ensuring no hidden limb fusion or impossible angles.

Fabric texture consistency (suit vs shirt vs tie)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hand-cuff interaction. AI often struggles with fingers gripping fabric. Check if the tie pattern has logical continuity or if it dissolves into noise. Verify if the lighting on the face matches the shadows on the neck naturally.
